passages.title: 사진 촬영 일정 안내 메일
passages.passage:
From: Marketing Team
To: All Staff
Subject: Team Photo Day

Hello everyone,

New photos for the company website will be taken next Tuesday in the main lobby. Each team has a 15-minute time slot; the schedule is attached.

Please wear your company shirt if you have one. If you cannot come at your team's time, email me to join another group.

Thanks,
Marketing Team

questions.q: What will happen next Tuesday?
choices: Company shirts will be handed out
questions.exKo: 화요일에 회사 웹사이트용 단체 사진을 촬영한다는 안내입니다.
why: 'New photos ... will be taken next Tuesday'가 촬영 일정
웹사이트용 사진일 뿐 사이트 개설 아님
회사 셔츠는 착용 요청이지 배부 아님
로비는 촬영 장소일 뿐 페인트 작업 언급 없음
questions.ev: New photos for the company website will be taken next Tuesday in the main lobby.

questions.q: How long is each team's time slot?
questions.exKo: Each team has a 15-minute time slot이라고 명시합니다.
questions.ev: Each team has a 15-minute time slot; the schedule is attached.

questions.q: What should staff do if they miss their team's time?
questions.exKo: email me to join another group이라고 안내합니다.
why: 'email me to join another group'이 대처 방법
questions.ev: If you cannot come at your team's time, email me to join another group.

passages.title: 제품 반품 절차 안내 메일
passages.passage:
From: Home Basics Store
To: Fred Nolan
Subject: How to Return Your Order

Dear Mr. Nolan,

We are sorry the desk lamp arrived with a broken switch. You do not need to send it back. Please recycle it locally.

A replacement lamp will ship tomorrow and arrive within three days. We have also emailed you a $5 coupon for the trouble.

Kind regards,
Home Basics Customer Care

questions.q: What was wrong with the lamp?
questions.exKo: arrived with a broken switch에서 스위치 불량임을 알 수 있습니다.
why: 'arrived with a broken switch'가 스위치 불량을 뜻함
questions.ev: We are sorry the desk lamp arrived with a broken switch.

questions.q: What should Mr. Nolan do with the broken lamp?
questions.exKo: 반송할 필요 없이 현지에서 재활용하라고 안내합니다.
why: 'Please recycle it locally'가 처리 방법을 명시
반송할 필요 없다고 했으므로 지문과 반대
questions.ev: You do not need to send it back. Please recycle it locally.

questions.q: When will the replacement ship?
questions.exKo: A replacement lamp will ship tomorrow라고 명시되어 있습니다.
why: 'will ship tomorrow'가 발송 시점을 알려 줌
questions.ev: A replacement lamp will ship tomorrow and arrive within three days.

passages.title: 회의실 예약 시스템 점검 공지
passages.passage:
SYSTEM MAINTENANCE NOTICE

The meeting room booking system will be offline this Sunday from 6 a.m. to noon for an update. Rooms cannot be booked or changed during this time.

Bookings made before Sunday are safe and will not be lost. For urgent bookings on Sunday morning, write your name on the paper sheet posted on each room's door.

IT Department

questions.q: What is happening on Sunday?
choices: The booking system will be updated
A new system will be sold
questions.exKo: 일요일 오전에 회의실 예약 시스템 업데이트가 진행됩니다.
why: 'offline this Sunday ... for an update'가 시스템 업데이트
예약만 중단될 뿐 회의실 폐쇄는 아님
questions.ev: The meeting room booking system will be offline this Sunday from 6 a.m. to noon for an update.

questions.q: What is stated about existing bookings?
questions.exKo: Bookings made before Sunday are safe and will not be lost라고 안내합니다.
why: 'are safe and will not be lost'와 그대로 일치
재예약이 필요 없다고 했으므로 지문과 반대
questions.ev: Bookings made before Sunday are safe and will not be lost.

questions.q: How can rooms be booked during the maintenance?
choices: By writing on the sheet on each door
They cannot be booked at all
questions.exKo: 각 회의실 문에 붙은 종이에 이름을 쓰라고 안내합니다.
why: 'write your name on the paper sheet'가 대체 방법
종이 방식이 있으므로 불가능하다는 것은 반대
questions.ev: write your name on the paper sheet posted on each room's door

passages.title: 겨울 난방 온도 조정 공지
passages.passage:
HEATING NOTICE

To save energy this winter, office heating will be set to 21 degrees during work hours. Heating turns on at 7 a.m. and off at 8 p.m. on weekdays.

Meeting rooms have their own controls; please turn heating off when you leave. Extra sweaters in team colors can be ordered from the supply office until Friday.

Building Services

questions.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
questions.exKo: 에너지 절약을 위한 겨울 난방 운영 방침 안내입니다.
why: 'To save energy this winter'가 난방 방침 안내 목적
스웨터는 사내 주문일 뿐 판매 광고 아님
난방 가동 시간일 뿐 근무 시간 변경 아님
questions.ev: To save energy this winter, office heating will be set to 21 degrees during work hours.

questions.q: What should people do when leaving a meeting room?
questions.exKo: please turn heating off when you leave라고 요청합니다.
why: 'turn heating off when you leave'가 요청 사항
questions.ev: Meeting rooms have their own controls; please turn heating off when you leave.

questions.q: What can be ordered until Friday?
questions.exKo: Extra sweaters in team colors can be ordered ... until Friday에서 확인됩니다.
why: 'sweaters in team colors ... until Friday'와 일치
questions.ev: Extra sweaters in team colors can be ordered from the supply office until Friday.

passages.title: 안경점 무료 검사 광고
passages.passage:
CLEAR VIEW OPTICAL — SEE THE DIFFERENCE

This month only, get a free eye exam with any purchase of glasses. Choose from over 300 frames, with lenses ready in just one hour.

Office workers: ask about our blue-light lenses that reduce eye strain from screens. We are located on the ground floor of the Metro Mall, next to the bank.

questions.q: What is offered this month?
choices: A free eye exam with glasses purchase
questions.exKo: 이번 달 안경 구매 시 무료 시력 검사를 제공한다는 광고입니다.

questions.q: How long does it take to prepare lenses?
questions.exKo: lenses ready in just one hour라고 안내합니다.

questions.q: What are blue-light lenses said to do?
questions.exKo: reduce eye strain from screens에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 호수 유람선 저녁 투어 광고
passages.passage:
SUNSET LAKE CRUISE — NOW BOOKING!

Enjoy a two-hour evening cruise on Lake Marion. Boats leave the North Dock daily at 6:30 p.m., May through September.

Tickets are $18 for adults and $9 for children under 12. Groups of ten or more save 20%. Light snacks and drinks are sold on board. Book at the dock office or online.

questions.q: What is being advertised?
questions.exKo: 호수에서 즐기는 2시간짜리 저녁 유람선 투어 광고입니다.

questions.q: How much is a child's ticket?
questions.exKo: $9 for children under 12라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: Who receives a 20% discount?
questions.exKo: Groups of ten or more save 20%에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 재활용 의류 수거함 설치 기사
passages.passage:
FAIRVIEW — The city placed 40 clothing donation boxes around town last month, and residents have already filled them twice. Donated clothes are cleaned and given to local charities or recycled into cleaning cloths.

"People want an easy way to give," said program manager Luis Vega. The city plans to add 20 more boxes near supermarkets, where most donations were collected.

questions.q: What is the article about?
choices: Clothing donation boxes in the city
questions.exKo: 시가 설치한 의류 기부함이 큰 호응을 얻고 있다는 기사입니다.

questions.q: What happens to donated clothes?
choices: They are cleaned and given to charities or recycled
questions.exKo: 세탁 후 자선단체에 전달되거나 청소용 천으로 재활용됩니다.

questions.q: Where will new boxes be placed?
questions.exKo: 기부가 가장 많았던 슈퍼마켓 근처에 20개를 추가할 계획입니다.

passages.title: 야시장 시범 운영 기사
passages.passage:
HARBORTON — A night market will run every Friday in June on Water Street. About 40 food stands and craft sellers will open from 5 to 10 p.m.

The street will close to cars during market hours. Free shuttle buses will run from City Hall every 15 minutes. If the June trial goes well, the market may continue through August, officials said.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
choices: A trial night market in June
questions.exKo: 6월 매주 금요일 시범 운영되는 야시장에 관한 기사입니다.

questions.q: How often will shuttle buses run?
questions.exKo: Free shuttle buses will run ... every 15 minutes라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: What may happen if the trial goes well?
choices: The market may continue through August
questions.exKo: the market may continue through August라고 관계자가 밝혔습니다.

passages.title: 명함 오타 확인 문자
passages.passage:
Print Shop (11:00 A.M.)
Hi Ms. Vargas, before we print your 500 business cards, please confirm: your title reads 'Snior Designer.' Is that correct?

Elena Vargas (11:05 A.M.)
Oh no, that's a typo! It should be 'Senior Designer.' Thank you for catching it.

Print Shop (11:06 A.M.)
No problem. We'll fix it and print this afternoon. Cards will be ready tomorrow at 10.

Elena Vargas (11:07 A.M.)
Wonderful. I'll pick them up tomorrow.

questions.q: Why did the print shop message Ms. Vargas?
questions.exKo: 인쇄 전에 직함 표기 오류를 확인하기 위한 연락입니다.

questions.q: What was wrong on the card?
questions.exKo: 'Snior Designer'는 'Senior Designer'의 오타였습니다.

questions.q: When will the cards be ready?
questions.exKo: Cards will be ready tomorrow at 10이라고 안내합니다.

passages.title: 야근 저녁 식사 문자
passages.passage:
Tara Singh (5:50 P.M.)
Team, we'll be here until about 9 tonight finishing the report. Dinner is on the company — pizza or Chinese?

Mark Cole (5:52 P.M.)
Pizza, please!

Jenny Wu (5:53 P.M.)
Pizza works for me too. Can we get one veggie?

Tara Singh (5:55 P.M.)
Sure. Ordering two large pizzas now — one veggie, one pepperoni. They'll arrive around 6:30.

Mark Cole (5:56 P.M.)
Great, thanks Tara!

questions.q: Why is the team staying late?
questions.exKo: finishing the report에서 보고서 마무리 때문임을 알 수 있습니다.

questions.q: Who pays for dinner?
questions.exKo: Dinner is on the company라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What will Ms. Singh order?
choices: One veggie and one pepperoni pizza
questions.exKo: one veggie, one pepperoni 두 판을 주문한다고 말합니다.
